claims.statement: At fixed mean-field barrier ΔΦ, mean collapse time ⟨T(p)⟩ is monotonically non-increasing in saddle index p.
claims.test: p-sweep with c(p) calibrated via find_c_for_target_barrier; ⟨T(p+1)⟩ < ⟨T(p)⟩ + 2·SEM for all p ∈ {1..4}.

claims.statement: log⟨T(p)⟩ vs p has slope -(1/2)·log(λ₊_measured) within 25% at fixed ΔΦ/ε.
claims.test: Linear regression of log⟨T(p)⟩ on p; compare slope to -0.5·log(λ₊) from measure_lambda_plus_sim.
claims.falsifier: Slope deviates from prediction by >25% or sign is wrong.

claims.statement: Locked-control ⟨T_lock(p)⟩ matches independent ⟨T_indep(p=1)⟩ within 2·SEM for all p.
claims.test: Run LockedHighDimDiversityModel for p ∈ {1..4}; compare to independent p=1.
claims.falsifier: ⟨T_lock(p)⟩ deviates from ⟨T_indep(1)⟩ by >2·SEM for any p.

claims.statement: Repair cost R(p) over fixed horizon grows super-linearly in p.
claims.test: Fit R(p) = α·p^β; require β > 1.2 with 95% CI excluding β=1.

claims.statement: Gaussian moment closure holds (|skew|<0.5, |excess kurt|<1.0) while D > 10·collapse_ε.
claims.falsifier: Either threshold exceeded before D crosses 10·collapse_ε.

claims.statement: Scaling exponent in C2 is N-independent for N ∈ {50, 200, 800} within SEM.
claims.test: Repeat C2 at three N values; compare slopes.
claims.falsifier: Slope changes by more than its SEM across N.

claims.statement: λ₊ measured from agent sim agrees with λ₊ from mean_field.lambda_plus within 15%.
claims.falsifier: Discrepancy >15% → moment closure broken or finite-N effect dominant.

claims.statement: Numerical bias in ⟨T⟩ from finite dt is below SEM at dt = 0.005 for σ=0.15, a=1.0.
